# Quality Indicators

This area groups the specific clinical metrics used to monitor, evaluate, and benchmark ADHD healthcare delivery in Denmark. It currently contains the national quality indicators managed by the ADHD-DATABASEN, which track both process and result milestones across assessment and treatment populations for children, adolescents, and adults. The metrics cover critical steps such as somatic evaluations, diagnostic conferences, cross-sectoral coordination, psychoeducation, and pharmacological treatments, highlighting systemic shortfalls and regional disparities in meeting the established 90% development goals.

## Pages

- [[topics/quality-indicators/adhd-care/index|Adhd Care]] — The complete set of national clinical quality indicators for ADHD care in Denmark, detailing process and result metrics, regional disparities, and systemic shortfalls across assessment and treatment populations.
